title: Data Analyst
summary: Solve real stakeholder inquiries, conversion drops, cohort retention shifts, and synthetic data validation anomalies.

industry_glossary.definition: The step-by-step journey users take toward a goal (e.g., Homepage -> Product Page -> Cart -> Checkout).
Tracking a specific group of users who share a common characteristic (such as sign-up week) over a period of time.
A trend that appears in several groups of data but disappears or reverses when the groups are combined.
When an apparent business decline is actually caused by broken telemetry code failing to log events rather than real user behavior.
A mathematical determination that an observed difference is unlikely to have occurred solely by random chance.

common_tools.name: SQL (Postgres, BigQuery, Snowflake)
common_tools.description: Writing performant analytical queries, window functions, and funnel step aggregations.

common_tools.name: Python & Pandas / Polars
common_tools.description: Cleaning synthetic datasets, calculating variance, and running hypothesis tests.

common_tools.name: Tableau / Looker / Metabase
common_tools.description: Constructing executive dashboards, cohort heatmaps, and funnel drop-off visualizers.

common_tools.name: Segment / Amplitude / Mixpanel
common_tools.description: Tracking user event journeys, identifying drop-off steps, and verifying client-side event instrumentation.

standard_workflows.summary: Verify event instrumentation health to rule out client logging bugs before accepting business drop-off claims.
Slice data across platform, app version, geography, and user tier to isolate anomalies to specific cohorts.
Test stakeholder assumptions against statistical evidence and eliminate spurious correlations.
Deliver bottom-line findings with clear operational recommendations and preventative instrumentation steps.

readiness_quiz.question: A product manager reports that checkout conversions plunged 40% yesterday. What is your first validation step before alarming leadership?
options: A) Verify if event logging instrumentation broke or if there was a frontend tracking bug deployed yesterday
B) Announce that the company's product has failed
C) Change the pricing model immediately
D) Delete the database records from yesterday
readiness_quiz.explanation: Often sudden, massive drops in conversion metrics are telemetry instrumentation failures (missing tracking tags) rather than sudden changes in human user behavior.

readiness_quiz.question: Why is segmenting metrics by platform (iOS, Android, Web) or country essential when investigating a sudden anomaly?
options: A) High-level aggregated metrics often mask that an issue is isolated to a single app version, OS build, or regional CDN
B) Because charts look better with more colors
C) Segmenting is only required for marketing teams
D) Aggregate data is never reliable
readiness_quiz.explanation: Segmenting isolates the root cause quickly—for instance, revealing that only iOS v12.1 users are experiencing checkout errors while web is normal.

readiness_quiz.question: What is the difference between correlation and causation in data analytics?
options: A) Correlation means two metrics move together; causation means one directly causes the other to change
B) Correlation applies only to revenue; causation applies only to latency
C) They are identical terms used interchangeably in data science
D) Causation is proven whenever a graph has an upward slope
readiness_quiz.explanation: Two metrics can correlate purely by seasonal coincidence. Establishing causation requires controlled experiments (A/B testing) or clear causal mechanisms.

readiness_quiz.question: When presenting findings to an executive stakeholder, how should you structure your report?
options: A) Executive Summary with key findings & recommended actions first, followed by supporting evidence and methodology
B) 100 pages of raw SQL queries without any conclusions
C) Blame the engineering team in paragraph one
D) Avoid providing any recommendations
readiness_quiz.explanation: Executives need the bottom-line decision impact immediately (Bottom Line Up Front / BLUF), with clear evidence backing it up.

readiness_quiz.question: What does a high cohort retention curve flattening out above 0% indicate?
options: A) The product has achieved healthy long-term product-market fit for that cohort
B) All users have churned completely
C) The database query has an infinite loop
D) The product needs to be shut down
readiness_quiz.explanation: When retention curves flatten parallel to the x-axis, a loyal core group of users continues returning indefinitely, indicating product-market fit.
